name: Nerflets
definition: Achieves efficient structure-aware 3D scene representation with only 2D supervision by representing a scene as a set of local neural radiance fields (Nerflets), each with orientation, spatial position, and range.
summary: Nerflets decomposes scenes into local neural radiance fields for efficient, structure-aware reconstruction, enabling 2D-supervised training and direct scene editing unlike global NeRF models.
